title: The Last Cover
author: Odile Vane
blurb: Juniper Crane, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
